sources.title: GenAI for Robotics: Fine-Tuning SmolVLA to Pick and Place | by ...
sources.snippet: Our objective was to take this general-purpose model and, through a process of fine-tuning, specialize it for a classic robotics task: picking up a cube in a simulated environment. SmolVLA lowers the barrier to entry for VLA research and development.
